objective: Run one complete OCLOB research lifecycle from a pre-authorized order through ordered malicious-secure MPC matching to threshold-authorized zkPI settlement and canonical DeFMI readback, while recording the trusted clear-order coordinator that remains in this slice.
official_upstream_exception: MP-SPDZ compile.py is permitted only as the official compiler invoked by the Rust orchestrator.

market.rough_slice: one resting sell and one arriving buy

current_trusted_component: the single-process coordinator receives the clear order before creating seven cryptographically randomized Shamir shares
rough_run_forbidden: plaintext order logging before ordering quorum
production_target: client-edge sharing so that the coordinator never receives the clear order
one share per independently operated MPC node

required: exactly five distinct valid order votes form the certificate
the MP-SPDZ process really executes and all seven parties agree on public output
the fill uses price-time priority and never exceeds either order remainder
no user or maker signature is requested after matching
zkPI contains threshold amount and price range evidence
DeFMI changes cash and securities atomically exactly once
canonical roots and sequence agree with the committed transition
a replay of the same instruction is rejected
reject_if: any secret is logged before the order certificate
fewer than five order votes are accepted
a cleartext matcher is substituted for the MP-SPDZ run

non_claims: The first rough run is a seven-process single-host committee, not a seven-region WAN.
The first rough run uses the in-process DeFMI state machine, not a live Avalanche validator network.
The first rough run proves the application seam and does not establish production throughput.
